problem_statement: Enterprise users integrating LangChain in regulated environments cannot configure mutual TLS, custom certificate chains, or corporate proxies on the Anthropic chat client, because ChatAnthropic does not accept a custom httpx client the way ChatOpenAI does. This blocks adoption in security-controlled deployments.
target_user: Platform engineers at regulated enterprises (finance, healthcare) who deploy LangChain behind corporate proxies and must enforce certificate-based auth and SSL verification policies.

user_stories.action: pass a pre-configured httpx client to ChatAnthropic
user_stories.value: I can enforce mTLS and route through our corporate proxy without forking the integration

user_stories.action: control SSL verification behavior on every outbound model call
user_stories.value: I can certify the deployment against our compliance baseline

acceptance_criteria.given: a ChatAnthropic instance configured with a custom httpx client
acceptance_criteria.when: the client issues a completion request
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is routed through the supplied httpx client, honoring its mTLS and proxy settings

acceptance_criteria.given: a custom httpx client with SSL verification disabled for an internal CA
acceptance_criteria.then: the verification setting from the supplied client is respected, not overridden by a default

acceptance_criteria.given: no custom httpx client is supplied
acceptance_criteria.then: it falls back to the existing default client with no behavior change for current users

success_metrics.name: regulated-deployment adoption
success_metrics.definition: count of enterprise accounts enabling the custom-httpx path in production within one quarter of release
success_metrics.target: at least 15 accounts in the first quarter

success_metrics.name: support ticket reduction
success_metrics.definition: monthly volume of proxy/SSL configuration support tickets for the Anthropic integration
success_metrics.target: reduce by 50 percent versus the trailing three-month average

out_of_scope: Changes to ChatOpenAI, which already supports custom httpx clients
Automatic proxy discovery from system environment
Certificate lifecycle management or rotation tooling

risks.description: A user-supplied httpx client with overly permissive SSL settings could weaken security posture without the team realizing it
Divergence from ChatOpenAI's exact configuration surface could create inconsistent cross-provider behavior
